name: logo-straight-v2
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied existing El Bebe kindergarten logo. Keep the recognizable white rabbit with round black glasses and pink ears peeking over the top left, the saturated seven puzzle-piece colors, white playful Cyrillic letters, purple supporting text and tiny yellow rays/heart. CHANGE GEOMETRY ONLY: straighten the entire logo. The seven interlocking puzzle tiles must form one perfectly straight HORIZONTAL row, equal-height central rectangular bodies, identical top and bottom horizontal alignment, no bowed ribbon, no arch, no wave, no tilted letters. The baseline of every letter in the main word must be the same straight horizontal y coordinate. Exact main word: «Эльбебе» (Э л ь б е б е — seven letters on seven tiles). The upper text «ДЕТСКИЙ САД» is one perfectly straight horizontal line, not curved, placed above the tile row to the right of the rabbit. Lower text «СОЧИ» is centered and perfectly horizontal. Preserve bunny illustration identity, do not add other mascots. Keep generous transparent margins so no puzzle knobs or ears are clipped. Flat clean logo on TRUE transparent background. No scenery, no plate, no floor shadow, no perspective, no mockup. Avoid any curvature of text or tile row. Wide logo composition around 1.8:1.

name: mobile-hero-concept-initial
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished mobile WEBSITE HERO SECTION design for the existing Russian kindergarten El Bebe site. Render a flat edge-to-edge screen, portrait 1170 x 2532 pixels, proportional to a real 390 x 844 CSS pixel phone viewport. NO phone bezel, NO browser chrome, NO presentation board, NO desktop version. Input image roles: 1 = corrected logo, preserve it exactly with perfectly horizontal puzzle row and horizontal text; 2 = main girl-painting photo; 3 = teacher with children secondary photo; 4 = current mobile website for exact brand palette and soft organic visual language, but replace its cramped side-by-side layout.
ART DIRECTION: creamy ivory #fffdf7 canvas, rich purple #6d2194 rounded heavy Nunito-style Russian typography, coral #ff686b pill CTA, soft aqua and pale pink organic shapes, tiny yellow rays and a few hand-drawn hearts. Warm and charming, spacious yet compact enough to work as the first screen. Refined real website layout, no generic cards.
COMPOSITION AT 390 CSS PX WIDTH: header about 90 px high, straight supplied logo at top left around 155 px wide and small purple hamburger at top right over a quiet aqua corner shape. Hero copy uses nearly full width with 22 px side margins. Small service line 'Частный детский сад в Сочи'. Bold left-aligned headline in TWO balanced lines: 'Здесь детство' then 'идёт своим ходом', roughly 32 px size, dark purple, fully readable. Under it short body copy in two lines: 'Играем, дружим и открываем мир.' then 'С заботой о каждом ребёнке.' with body size 15 px. One coral CTA 'Прийти познакомиться' with a white right arrow, around 52 px high, generous horizontal width. Under CTA compact trust row or two short lines with small outlined icons: 'Виноградная · Сочи' and 'Лицензия · Оплата маткапиталом'.
BELOW all the text: a beautiful large photo collage about 285 px high, occupying most of screen width. Main girl-painting photo from image 2 in a soft asymmetrical organic cutout toward right, keep entire face visible and show brush and colorful paints. One smaller circular photo of teacher and children from image 3 overlaps the collage at lower left with a thin ivory separator. All text is ABOVE this collage, never on a face or over a photograph. A pink backing shape peeks out from behind the photos, a tiny yellow heart and aqua drop sit in free margins. Do not clutter with extra text inside the photo collage. Near bottom a compact row of 3 simple colorful vector icons with short two-line labels: 'Забота каждый день', 'Развитие через игру', 'Детство в Сочи'. The very bottom may show only the start of the next heading 'Развиваем важные навыки', no more of the next section.
CONSTRAINTS: render all provided Russian wording correctly; legible realistic mobile type, consistent spacing; logo letters and puzzle pieces strictly straight, no curved lettering; no overlapping copy and photography; no fake ratings, ages, prices or statistics; no extra CTA; no giant empty areas. This is a proposed design image, not a screenshot of an implemented change.
